scope: Recovered three-book reader and scoped Stage X UI fixes. Browser evidence below is tied to its exact CI revision; final source integration requires another source audit and browser run.

diff_whitespace.scope: UI, test, QA record and preview-workflow changes; parallel source integration is validated separately.

fixes.problem: Focus view hid the contents panel even when its mobile drawer was opened; desktop search also targeted the hidden panel.
fixes.change: Make Focus contents available as a temporary drawer on desktop and mobile, preserve the reading view, and synchronize inert state when the view changes.
fixes.browser_assertions: Focus search visibility and keyboard focus, Escape restoration, desktop continuous-mode interaction, and mobile drawer close.

fixes.problem: A Reading Desk already open in one tab did not refresh when another reader tab saved a note or bookmark.
fixes.change: Dispatch the shared desk update after a validated storage event and reader redraw.
fixes.browser_assertions: Edit a note through a second reader tab and require the already-open first-tab desk to display the new text.

fixes.problem: Edition-mode rules suppressed the Arabic or English side of bilingual authorial notes even when an explicit print language required that side.
fixes.change: Apply explicit English, Arabic or bilingual print selection to authorial notes; retain edition defaults when no override is selected.
fixes.browser_assertions: Within the existing print-range test, render a runtime-only bilingual-note fixture and verify Arabic-only output under Reading layout, then restore the prior view.

fixes.problem: Changing the reading view at M-V-28 selected the first subsection of its shared chapter (M-V-27), so the editions return link subsequently pointed at the wrong subsection.
fixes.change: Capture the visible reading unit before the view redraw and navigate back to that unit. Use the same current-unit selection for shared reader controls.
fixes.browser_assertions: Require M-V-28 to remain selected immediately after choosing Focus, and retain the existing M-V-28 editions-return assertion.
fixes.validation: JavaScript syntax and diff checks passed locally; the behavioral fix awaits the next CI run.

fixes.problem: Reviewed dictionary excerpts displayed literal Markdown emphasis markers around terms such as Mental (dhihniyya).
fixes.change: Render quote emphasis through the existing shared inline renderer, which escapes source text before adding its limited strong/em markup.
fixes.browser_assertions: Within the existing mental-existence dictionary scenario, require the M-C-10 excerpt to contain rendered strong emphasis and no literal double-asterisk markers.
fixes.validation: JavaScript syntax and scoped diff checks passed locally; browser validation awaits the next CI run.
